results.name: federatedIdentityCredential
results.reason: Exact current and latest-GA 2024-11-30 Learn and pinned REST schemas were checked. The three required properties are present; issuer is URI, subject is string, audiences is array<string>. The generated credential name satisfies the exact REST path regex. The configured issuer is AKS oidcIssuerProfile.issuerURL with that profile enabled; the exact subject, name, and default audience resolve from the unmodified Bicep caller and match published Microsoft Learn conventions.
results.migration: Current 2024-11-30 is already latest GA. Pinned REST metadata contains FIC stable schemas 2023-01-31 and 2024-11-30; later 2025 API versions are previews and are not migration candidates.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: Original Bicep JSON Pointer /name maps to required REST path parameter federatedIdentityCredentialResourceName. Caller resolves namespace=chaos-lab and service account=chaos-app-sa, producing k8s-chaos-lab-chaos-app-sa; it passes the exact OpenAPI name pattern (first alphanumeric; remaining alphanumeric/dash/underscore, length 3–120).

usage.label: parent
usage.analysis: Bicep parent selects the userAssignedManagedIdentity resource and supplies the parent path segment userAssignedIdentities/{resourceName}; it is a deployment relationship, not a REST JSON property. The FIC endpoint path confirms the nested parent-resource route.

usage.label: properties
usage.analysis: The nested FederatedIdentityCredentialProperties schema requires issuer, subject, and audiences. All three are supplied in the source object and are analyzed individually below.

usage.label: issuer
usage.analysis: REST properties.issuer is required string format uri. The caller passes the AKS module output oidcIssuerUrl, sourced from aksCluster.properties.oidcIssuerProfile.issuerURL; the AKS module enables oidcIssuerProfile. No Azure/runtime value was queried.

usage.label: subject
usage.analysis: REST properties.subject is required string. The source expression resolves to system:serviceaccount:chaos-lab:chaos-app-sa; Microsoft Learn documents system:serviceaccount:<namespace>:<service-account> as the Kubernetes token subject format.

usage.label: audiences
usage.analysis: REST properties.audiences is required array<string>. The single element resolves to api://AzureADTokenExchange because the module caller omits audience and the parameter default supplies this value; Microsoft Learn recommends this audience for direct federation.
